findings.why: Viteria Lanzo has no supplier id and appears in none of the documents, so we have no supplier record for it. A person must confirm its standing and qualification before it can receive HB-620.

findings.why: No controlled record covers Viteria Lanzo for HB-620, the receiving plant or the customer (Nordhavn, from the 8D). Dora's approval for HB-620 was revoked on 2026-09-15, so a new approved source is needed. The absence of a record cannot be read as "not approved", so a person must clarify.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material.

findings.why: This is a change of source for HB-620, whose drawing material is MAT-ALSI9CU3. No 3.1 certificate from Viteria Lanzo is in the documents, so the supplier quality engineer must obtain one.
